cases.instruction: List the first 100 edits ever made to the Wikipedia article Brainfuck (the oldest 100), each with its date and time, the editor, and the edit summary; leave out the page's navigation and filter controls.
List every post the Google Online Security Blog published in 2015, with its title, date and link; leave out posts from 2014 or earlier and the sidebar archive links.
List the original 151 Pokémon (Pokédex numbers 1 to 151) by name, with each one's detail URL; leave out any Pokémon after number 151.
List every tokio release before 1.0 (all 0.x versions, alphas included) with its version number and publish date; leave out every 1.x release.
List every article in this search for papers with 'tardigrade' in the title published 2016 to 2018, with title, journal and publication year.
List every Rick and Morty character whose name contains the given name, with species and status; leave out characters whose name does not contain it.
List every headword in the Jargon File dictionary that starts with the given word; leave out matches from other dictionaries.
List every Project Gutenberg book with the given author among its authors, with its ebook number, title and language; leave out books by other people that only mention the author.
